review_scope: Independent source review of seven-file AO LOG1P BA16 v1 proposal; no edits, build, or GPU execution

evidence: ao_prepass.wgsl fragment_main: tag1, log2(1+clamp(depth,0,far))/step, clamp0..65534 then +1
ao_generate.wgsl decode_view_depth and mesh.wgsl screen_space_ao_visibility: exp2((code-1)*same step)-1
code0 checked before unsigned subtraction in all decode call paths; code1 remains valid zero-depth
ao_math.rs: fixed native far15000 and log2(15001)/65534; tag1 in camera_forward.w
source_findings.assessment: Native world-space view depth and reconstruction units agree. Camera near can change independently; near0 is not background because depth zero maps to code1.

evidence: portal_gpu/init.rs initializes AO uniform through make_uniform
render_frame.rs lines200-201 writes uniform copy before record_ao_pass on the same encoder
AoTargets::record clears BA to0 and AO towhite every recorded pass
AoTargets pipelines are created from embedded shader sources with cache:None; AO resources/private views cannot persist across binaries
rebuild_ao_resources recreates views/bindings and uses same factory/layout
source_findings.assessment: Within one coherently rebuilt binary the version cannot change through public settings. Disabled/no-target/no-mesh factory sets enabled0; mesh consumer returns neutral. Same-target two-frame hole/solid GPU test will exercise warm overwrite, but remains unexecuted after fix.

evidence: ao_depth::encode_depth rejects NaN/Inf/out-of-range only under cfg(test)
ao_math::camera_basis falls back for nonfinite/zero direction; depth step/far/version are fixedfinite
make_uniform and PortalGpu::set_screen_space_ao use clamp, which does not sanitize NaN radius/strength/bias
public camera setters/CameraState.clamped do not comprehensively sanitize NaN yaw/pitch/target
source_findings.assessment: CPU invalid-depth oracle tests do not prove runtime invalid-camera/AO-input rejection. This behavior exists in original factory/settings and is outside the seven-file change; do not advertise fail-closed arbitrary NaN input qualification. Native settings owner needs explicit reject/preserve validation and tests before such a claim.

source_findings.topic: reproduced precision fault and new GPU behavior
evidence: old actual GPU hole18/solid15 agrees with native camera ray/plane oracle
far15000/65534 gives about0.228889 world-unit depth step; AO horizon ramp0.04 and radius0.05..2.0 overlap that lost precision
new analytic-code oracle uses actual CameraState, half-target pixel center and expected world planes; original >100-code assertion retained
source_findings.assessment: Independent equations and Naga validation are sufficient for source review, not successful actual GPU precision or visual qualification. Parent must run the strengthened native pixel test and relevant AO/material family on the coherent final binary.

decision: No blocking source-format/consumer/version wiring defect found for the declared bounded finite-camera repair. This is not blanket approval or GPU/quality acceptance. Runtime NaN admission and actual GPU execution remain explicitly unqualified.
